jobs.title: Senior LNG & Natural Gas Analyst (Europe focus)

Working as part of the LNG & Natural Gas Insight team, you will regularly publish market-defining reports and engage directly with clients, industry leaders, and media to present Kpler’s house views.

jobs.title: Senior LNG Market Analyst
jobs.description_text: As a Senior LNG Market Analyst, you will play a central role in driving the accuracy, depth, and strategic value of Kpler’s global Gas & LNG intelligence. Embedded within the Gas & LNG market operations team, you will bridge the gap between physical market dynamics and advanced data analytics to maintain trusted cargo-level data. Working closely with Product, Engineering, News, and Sales teams, you will turn complex trade datasets into actionable insights and shape future platform developments for our global clients.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Marine Insurance
jobs.description_text: As Senior Product Manager, Marine Insurance, you will own the Marine Insurance product end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build a new product offering that brings together Kpler's vessel, ownership, port, and trade-flow data to address critical challenges across the marine insurance value chain. Your initial focus will be on building an exposure screening product for insured fleets, enabling customers to load their insured fleet, attach policy values, and continuously monitor exposure and accumulation against the live global fleet picture. This is a high-impact opportunity to build a new product category from the ground up. You will work directly with underwriters, brokers, P&I clubs, claims and exposure-management teams, as well as Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing, to ensure the product solves real customer problems and establishes Kpler as a trusted source of marine insurance intelligence. The role is ideal for an experienced product leader who is comfortable operating in an ambiguous, early-stage environment and has a track record of taking B2B data, analytics, or SaaS products from concept through to customer adoption.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Fisheries / IUUF
jobs.description_text: As Senior Product Manager, Fisheries, you will own the Fisheries product end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build a new product offering that brings together Kpler's vessel, ownership, port, and trade-flow data to address growing challenges around seafood supply chain transparency and illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing. Your initial focus will be on building live fleet monitoring and catch and yield reporting, enabling procurement and compliance teams to monitor vessels, understand fishing activity, and access reliable information to support their due-diligence and traceability requirements. This is a high-impact opportunity to build a new product category from the ground up. You will work directly with seafood buyers, retailers, processors, certification bodies, regulators, RFMO stakeholders, and NGOs, as well as Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing teams, to ensure the product delivers trusted and actionable intelligence. The role is ideal for an experienced product leader who is comfortable operating in an ambiguous, early-stage environment and has a track record of taking B2B data, analytics, or SaaS products from concept through to customer adoption.

jobs.description_text: As a Refined Products Inventory Analyst, you will play a central role in powering Kpler's storage intelligence and driving the expansion of our brand-new inventory product from regional hubs to global coverage. Operating at the intersection of data operations, satellite imagery validation, and oil market analysis, you will ensure the precision, completeness, and strategic value of our global refined products dataset. By mapping terminal infrastructure and translating complex data into actionable market intelligence, you will directly empower commodity traders and market participants to navigate evolving energy dynamics with confidence.

jobs.title: Senior Research Analyst, Fuel oil
jobs.description_text: As we look to build out the role of research within Kpler we are adding experienced market professionals with solid backgrounds across the worlds of trading, refining, fundamental analytics and consulting. The successful candidate will be instrumental in expanding the geographical scope of our dirty product research offering, by adding Europe-based fuel oil and residue, expertise. This role will be pivotal in expanding our footprint in the European area and also be of great help to the growing client engagement team.

Operating with high autonomy, you will oversee end-to-end field operations across the United States—identifying optimal locations, negotiating access with private landowners, and installing physical sensor infrastructure. In this dynamic role, your field execution directly expands our proprietary ground network, empowering global commodity and energy markets with real-time, actionable insights.

jobs.description_text: We are seeking a Tax Expert to join our growing Finance team and provide operational support across Kpler’s global tax activities. In this role, you will work closely with the Group Tax Manager, Finance teams and external tax advisors to support tax analysis, projections, compliance, transfer pricing and international tax matters. This is a hands-on role with global exposure, offering the opportunity to work across multiple jurisdictions and contribute to tax-related projects and process improvements. You will play an important role in ensuring Kpler’s tax requirements are managed accurately and efficiently, while supporting the wider Finance organisation and helping to identify potential tax risks. The ideal candidate will be analytical, organised and comfortable working with financial data, external advisors and stakeholders across the business. You will be able to work independently, manage multiple priorities and communicate tax matters clearly to both tax and non-tax audiences.

jobs.title: Director of Agricultural Development
jobs.description_text: Rainmaker is pioneering a modern precipitation enhancement cloud seeding system to solve water scarcity. We develop and incorporate radar validation, weather-resistant UAS, and numerical weather modeling to make water abundant. As Rainmaker’s Director of Agricultural Development, you will own our engagement with the U.S. Department of Agriculture and the agricultural community in Washington. You will build the programs, partnerships, and funding pathways that connect precipitation enhancement to the conservation and water supply needs of American producers, and you will own the Congressional relationships and coalition presence that make the work durable. This position is based in Washington, DC. Significant stock options with high potential upside as an early-stage company 401(k) with employer matching Full health coverage (medical, dental, and vision insurance) Relocation assistance provided (if applicable) Unlimited PTO Paid parental leave for both parents

jobs.description_text: Lead Program Systems Engineer, Cyclops DESCRIPTION The Lead Systems Engineer for the Cyclops Interceptor Program owns system level requirements, architecture, interface definition, and verification planning for Long Wall’s interceptor. This role provides the technical backbone of the program, ensuring that all engineering work across propulsion, avionics, structures, mechanisms, GNC, software, and integration aligns with a coherent and traceable system design. Operating closely with the program’s Chief Engineer, Project Engineer and Responsible Engineers, the Lead Systems Engineer creates and maintains the structured technical framework that enables disciplined development. They ensure that architectures scale, requirements remain traceable, interfaces stay stable, and verification flows match both government‑funded testing and rapid internal development. jobs.title: Manager, Cost Accounting
jobs.description_text: Manager, Cost Accounting DESCRIPTION The Manager, Cost Accounting will own and lead the cost accounting and inventory accounting functions within the Accounting team. This role will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of manufacturing costs and inventory balances, supporting the month-end close and budgeting processes, and providing financial insights to support operational and business decision-making. Reporting directly to the Controller, the Manager, Cost Accounting will work closely with the broader Finance and Accounting team and partner cross-functionally with Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, and other teams throughout the organization. We are looking for someone with strong cost accounting and manufacturing experience who can both manage day-to-day accounting activities and help develop and scale our processes as the organization grows. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, comfortable working with detailed operational data, and able to translate complex cost information into meaningful financial insights. Experience within aerospace & defense, automotive, or another complex manufacturing environment is preferred. The compensation range for this role is $130,000 - $170,000/yr This is the lowest-to-highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Specialist, Strategic Vendors
jobs.description_text: Supply Chain Specialist, Strategic Vendors DESCRIPTION The Supply Chain Specialist, Strategic Vendors will own Long Wall’s most critical supplier relationships, serving as the primary point of contact and accountable owner for vendors supporting our missile defense programs. This role manages the supplier lifecycle end-to-end, from sourcing and selection through negotiation, onboarding, delivery, and ongoing performance management for the Company’s most important vendors. Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, and Legal, this person will ensure that our suppliers meet demanding technical, scheduling, and compliance requirements. The role will also include regular travel to supplier sites for capability assessments, business reviews, and hands-on issue resolution. You will champion product management excellence, oversee project staffing, and mentor a diverse and talented team, while also contributing to project work. Working closely with directors in product design, engineering, and content design you will foster a culture of collaboration and innovation, driving user impact and continuous improvement in our work. We are seeking candidates with a minimum of 7 years of professional experience in product management, along with at least 2 years of experience in people management. The ideal candidate will be a seasoned product manager adept at guiding end-to-end development, product planning, and execution, contributing to both product practice development and broader leadership and management functions within the office. This role will report to the Chief Innovation Officer, co-lead the product team with the current director of product, and work closely with initiative leads and other team members across the office.

In addition, the Developer will be responsible for creating permitting documents and support and lead project development tasks for assigned projects. The Developer will also manage third-party contractors, prepare and execute land use permits, plan and organize public outreach, and represent Pivot at land use hearings. The individual will be provided with the tools and resources for successful delivery of this role, which will lead to growth for both the individual and Pivot Energy. You set direction and vision, and you are also hands-on: close to customers, close to engineering, and comfortable making the calls on what gets built and in what order. jobs.title: Integration Embedded Engineer
jobs.description_text: You'd join Embedded Platform, the team inside Samba's TV engineering org that turns Samba's ACR technology - audio, video, and TV signal capture - into something that actually runs on hardware. That means writing to spec, working directly with OEM and SOC engineering teams, and validating what partners ship back before Samba can use any of it. This is about as upstream as it gets: if the signal doesn't get captured off the device, there's no TV data downstream, and TV data is the base layer Samba's whole business is built on. Beyond the core ACR work, the team also powers mobile apps that use TV viewership data and an edge AI feature that recognizes video game titles and shoppable items showing up on screen. Q4 brings a new OEM project live - Sony's audio ACR work and the Titan OS integration are both active right now. Whether that runs in parallel with everything else already on the team's plate, or reshuffles who's working on what, depends on who's in this seat.

You will serve as the bridge between marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, and finance, so that every team works from the same numbers and the same definitions. jobs.description_text: LilEngine is leading the Lakehouse, a company-strategic effort to make Apache Iceberg a first-class citizen in Spotify's data ecosystem. We're building it in close collaboration with Google, on open standards, so that different kinds of data are queryable the same way and teams can bring the right engine, from BigQuery to Dataflow to Trino, to the job. The work has two parts. Hecate enables Iceberg for the Parquet datasets that already exist across Spotify, so teams get the benefits without rewriting their data. Alongside it, we're building the foundations of a new Lakehouse architecture that lets workflows write Iceberg tables natively. We're shipping the MVP this cycle, and you'll help shape what comes next. We also own BigQuery for all of Spotify. Thousands of engineers, data scientists and pipelines depend on it every day, which puts us on the critical path for storing, finding and querying data. We're judged on reliability, cost efficiency and how quickly we unblock users when something breaks. This backend role sits where open table formats, cloud data warehouses and processing engines meet.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer II - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: Every dataset at Spotify, from the data behind creator royalties to the signals powering recommendations, is registered, published and traced through systems our team builds. We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next. These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide. This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.

If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We’re seeking a Senior Product Manager to help lead the audiobook experience across Spotify’s mobile apps. You’ll join Format Foundations within Core Experience and partner closely with the Audiobooks business unit to shape how listeners discover, evaluate, enjoy, and build lasting relationships with audiobooks on Spotify.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Subscriptions
jobs.description_text: Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators. The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify's subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly. This role focuses on the awareness, acquisition, and activation layers of the Subscriptions Mission, making Premium feel unmissable to free users long before a purchase decision. You'll own the strategy for how users discover, understand, and develop intent for Premium value, partnering closely with product, design, engineering, research, marketing, and data science to shape the moments, surfaces, and experiences that drive consideration across markets and segments.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - User Platform
jobs.description_text: The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers. User Platform builds the identity and access capabilities that help people use Spotify safely and easily. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to shape how people access Spotify and stay connected across our apps, devices, and strategic partner integrations. You’ll focus on session management - how Spotify recognizes someone after they sign in, maintains their access, and enables them to connect or disconnect devices and applications. You’ll bring together consumer experience and technical product strategy, working closely with engineering, design, research, insights, security, and teams responsible for Spotify’s clients and partnerships. Your decisions will help people get to the experiences they want, stay in control of their access, and use Spotify with confidence.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description_text: The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spotify is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Authorization team within Platform. Our team builds and operates the authorization and permissioning systems that enable creators and their teams to securely access and manage their presence across Spotify. What began by supporting Spotify for Artists has grown into foundational capabilities used across Spotify, including Music, Podcasts, and Audiobooks. This is a backend-focused role working on systems that sit on a critical path for Spotify's creator ecosystem. You'll help us evolve these systems as they grow in scale and complexity, bringing strong backend engineering expertise while collaborating across product, frontend, and data when needed.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Content Platform
jobs.description_text: Content Platform is responsible for ingesting, processing, storing, and delivering every piece of content on Spotify — from music and podcasts to audiobooks. Within Content Platform, the Media domain owns the end-to-end media pipeline, from the moment content arrives through to seamless playback for listeners around the world. We're looking for a Staff Engineer to provide architectural leadership across this media platform. You’ll help shape and drive the technical direction from ingestion through transcoding, packaging, storage, delivery, and playback. This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, understands the trade-offs between codec choices and infrastructure costs, and can drive technical strategy across multiple teams at scale.

This position will report into the Senior Manager for Indirect Tax in EMEA and APAC and will be based in Stockholm, Sweden. In your role, you will focus on compliance and reporting. Spotify reports indirect taxes in more than 90 countries globally and you will be a key member of the team responsible for ensuring the completeness, timeliness and accuracy of Spotify’s global indirect tax compliance obligations. You will work in close collaboration with global tax team members in both Stockholm and New York, and work cross functionally with various accounting and finance teams. We are a team of highly skilled and dedicated colleagues and we offer a challenging and dynamic role in an ever changing environment with the opportunity to take on much responsibility in a rapidly growing international company. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences audio.

The successful candidate will work under the guidance of experienced systems engineers while taking increasing ownership of defined work packages.

jobs.title: TCC Technologist
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Technical Control Centre (TCC) Technologist works as part of a large team providing network surveillance, control, pro-active corrective and preventative maintenance support to Telesat's customers on a 24 hour, 7 day basis. The TCC technologist proactively monitors network services and fixed satellite service customers, and manages the troubleshooting and investigation of reported faults until services have been restored. They perform hands-on corrective and preventative measures to Allan Park earth station critical systems, TT&C ground communications equipment, and on-site customer services.

jobs.title: Technical Program Integration Lead
jobs.description_text: The Technical Program Integration Lead serves as the focal point for integrated planning and execution within a major program segment, product area, or technical domain This role bridges technical complexity and program execution by transforming multiple engineering, product, software, hardware, operations, integration, and supplier workstreams into a cohesive, executable, and measurable program plan. Working across technical teams, systems engineering, program management, and program controls organizations, the Senior Technical Program Integration Lead ensures scope, dependencies, risks, readiness criteria, and delivery commitments are accurately represented within the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and broader program framework Unlike a traditional Project Manager or Integrated Program Controls Analysts, this role drives technical planning maturity, cross-functional alignment, and execution discipline while ensuring technical teams operate as a fully integrated part of the overall program The role is accountable for establishing and maintaining a credible, integrated execution plan, identifying, and proposing workarounds and mitigations for risks and dependencies early, and enabling leadership to make informed decisions based on clear assessments of program readiness and execution health Success in this position requires strong technical acumen, systems-level thinking, and the ability to influence diverse stakeholders toward a common execution strategy

jobs.title: Technical Writer, User Terminal (UT) Engineering
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Technical Writer will support the User Terminal (UT) Engineering team by developing, maintaining, and improving technical documentation throughout the product lifecycle for Telesat Lightspeed User Terminals. The role will work closely with product managers, engineers, subject matter experts, and UT leadership to ensure documentation is accurate, consistent, traceable, and professionally presented. The successful candidate will be responsible for transforming complex technical information into clear, structured documentation suitable for engineering teams, suppliers, integrators, manufacturing partners, and internal stakeholders. The role will help refine documentation standards, improve document quality, manage document reviews, and ensure requirements traceability across the UT product portfolio.

jobs.title: User Terminal Program Manager, Mil-Ka
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: As User Terminal (UT) Program Manager, Mil-Ka, this position will join the User Terminal development team responsible for the development, integration, qualification, delivery, and deployment of Mil-Ka user terminal solutions supporting Telesat Lightspeed government and defence programs. The UT Program Manager, Mil-Ka will lead the programmatic execution of external vendor terminal development programs and serve as a primary interface between Telesat and its user terminal suppliers. The role will coordinate closely with Telesat engineering, product management, systems engineering, PMO, procurement, contracts, and other stakeholders to ensure terminal solutions meet technical, schedule, cost, quality, and program objectives. This role requires a seasoned program manager with demonstrated experience managing complex satellite communications or similar hardware/software development programs through design, integration, verification, manufacturing readiness, delivery, and deployment. Experience developing satellite communications equipment or user terminals for government, defence, or other mission-critical applications is highly desirable. Success in this role requires a proactive, results-driven program manager with a high degree of initiative and strong communication skills, able to drive execution across cross-functional organizations and external suppliers while operating effectively in a complex government program environment.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Consultant - Forward Deployed AI Security Engineer
jobs.description_text: The Forward Deployed AI Security Engineer is a customer-facing technical operator who lives inside client environments, not behind a ticket queue. You will sit with security, platform, and AI engineering teams to assess how generative and agentic systems actually behave at runtime, then design, deploy, tune, and operationalize AI security controls that hold up under production load. You will install, configure, integrate, and defend tools in live estates: Palo Alto Prisma AIRS, Koi Agentic Endpoint Security, Onyx, Zenity, Zscaler AI Security, and CrowdStrike Falcon AIDR. You will write the findings, brief executives, train operators, and stay until the control plane is working — not until the workshop ends. Because you represent the company in high-stakes rooms, written and spoken English must be exceptional. You will produce assessment reports, architecture decisions, runbooks, and executive briefings that are precise, defensible, and free of ambiguity.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Consultant - Security GRC

jobs.title: Senior Technical Consultant, Data
jobs.description_text: The Senior Technical Consultant is an experienced, client-facing technical professional responsible for leading the design and hands-on delivery of complex data, analytics, AI, cloud, and modern data platform solutions. Operating between the Technical Consultant and Principal Technical Consultant levels, the role combines deep technical execution with solution leadership, consultative problem solving, client engagement, and team enablement. Senior Technical Consultants independently own significant technical workstreams and solution components, translate business and technical requirements into scalable implementations, guide other engineers, and ensure work is tested, documented, secure, maintainable, and production-ready. They are expected to lead through technical credibility and hands-on delivery while escalating enterprise architecture, cross-workstream governance, or critical technical decisions to the Principal Technical Consultant or Solution Architect when appropriate. Beyond client delivery, Senior Technical Consultants strengthen the Data Practice by mentoring less-experienced technical consultants, contributing reusable engineering patterns and standards, supporting technical discovery and proposal development, and continuously expanding expertise across modern data, cloud, governance, analytics, and AI technologies.

Our work centers on four pillars: AD/ADAS, our autonomous driving and advanced driver assist technologies; Arene, our software development platform for software-defined vehicles; Woven City, a test course for mobility; and Cloud & AI, the digital infrastructure powering our collaborative foundation. Business-critical functions empower these teams to execute, and together, we’re working toward one bold goal: a world with zero accidents and enhanced well-being for all. =========================================================================

Lyft Urban Solutions conçoit, fabrique et exploite des systèmes de vélopartage dans plus de 50 villes à travers le monde, dont New York, Chicago, Londres, Barcelone, Mexico, Rio de Janeiro et Montréal. Notre usine de Longueuil est le berceau de BIXI, le premier système de vélopartage automatisé en Amérique du Nord, et fabrique aujourd'hui les vélos et les stations de certains des plus grands réseaux de vélopartage au monde. Nous recherchons un ou une stagiaire en ingénierie d'industrialisation pour se joindre à notre équipe Ingénierie de la fabrication et de la qualité (Manufacturing & Quality Engineering) à notre usine de Longueuil. Vous travaillerez sur le plancher de production avec les équipes d'assemblage, d'entrepôt et de qualité afin de rendre nos procédés plus rapides, plus sécuritaires et plus constants. Vous ferez également partie d'une équipe mondiale qui soutient des usines et des fournisseurs en Amérique du Nord et en Asie. Responsabilités : Cartographier le flux de matières et l'aménagement actuel de l'usine et de l'entrepôt, puis proposer des améliorations pour réduire le gaspillage et les déplacements des opérateurs. Réaliser des études de temps de cycle pour les opérations d'assemblage et d'entrepôt afin de repérer les goulots d'étranglement et d'améliorer le débit et l'équilibrage des lignes. Auditer le respect des instructions d’assemblage sur le plancher, cerner les écarts et piloter les mesures
